settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square image, at least 64 × 64px.

settings.content: Defaults are contrast-checked (WCAG 2.2 AA) against the grounds they sit on. If you change them, keep text at 4.5:1 and control borders, stars and focus rings at 3:1.

settings.label: Hairlines and dividers (sand)
settings.info: Decorative only — never used for text or control borders.

settings.label: Borders on controls
settings.info: Inputs, size buttons, chips. Needs 3:1 against the background.

settings.label: Buy buttons (terracotta)
settings.info: Reserved for buying actions — Add to basket, Checkout, the finder's final Add. Keeping it rare is what makes it stand out.

settings.label: Low stock
settings.info: Only ever shown for real low stock.

settings.label: Reveal sections on scroll
settings.info: Visitors who ask their device for reduced motion never see movement either way.

settings.content: These numbers appear under every Add to basket button, in the basket and across the site. They are promises to customers — make each one match your real policies before you publish.

settings.label: Trial length (nights)
settings.info: Must match your real returns policy.

settings.label: We collect trial returns free
settings.info: Untick if customers pay to return a bed. Must match your returns policy. Lines that only promise free collection hide when it's off, and the standard wording below changes with it.

settings.label: Trial terms (one sentence)
settings.info: Shown under Add to basket, in the basket, in the Bed Finder and wherever a section uses [trial_terms]. Leave blank for the standard wording, which follows the tick box above: "If it isn't right, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full." Must match your returns policy.

settings.label: Trial terms, short
settings.info: A few words for trust rows and the comparison table, or [trial_terms_short] in a section. Leave blank for "Free collection, full refund" (follows the tick box above).

settings.label: Not covered by the trial
settings.info: One per line. A product is left out when its product type contains a line, or it has a tag that equals a line. Tag a product trial:no to leave it out, or trial:yes to include it whatever this list says. Must match your returns policy (personalised items can't be returned).
settings.default:
Dog Houses
Personalised
Dog car seat

settings.label: Guarantee length (years)
settings.info: Must match your written guarantee. Also the basis of the per-night price.

settings.label: Free delivery over (£)
settings.info: Must match your shipping rates in Settings → Shipping and delivery. Drives the progress bar in the basket.

settings.label: Show dispatch countdown
settings.info: Shows a live "order within … for dispatch today" countdown and an arrival estimate. Turn on only once the cut-off, dispatch days and delivery times below match what actually happens for every product, including supplier-fulfilled ones.

settings.label: Store time zone
settings.info: IANA name, e.g. Europe/London. The cut-off is counted in this time zone, wherever the shopper is.

settings.label: Same-day dispatch cut-off (24h clock)
settings.info: Orders before this hour on a dispatch day go out that day. Must be your real cut-off.

settings.label: Dispatch days
settings.info: Comma separated: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday … 6 = Saturday.

settings.label: Delivery takes at least (working days)
settings.info: From dispatch to door. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding the dates below.

settings.label: No dispatch or delivery on
settings.info: One date per line, YYYY-MM-DD. Pre-filled with England & Wales bank holidays to the end of 2027 — add your own closures.

settings.content: One short line under every Add to basket button and above Checkout in the basket, so shoppers know their delivery choices before checkout. Each part hides when left blank. Make them match Settings → Shipping and delivery exactly.

settings.label: Standard delivery
settings.info: Shown once the item or basket reaches the free-delivery amount above; below it the line says "Free UK delivery on orders over £40" instead.

settings.label: Faster option
settings.info: e.g. "Express delivery £6.99 at checkout". Must match the price of your express rate.

settings.label: Delivery times
settings.info: e.g. "Standard 3–5 working days, Express 1–2 working days". Leave blank until your real transit times are confirmed: it must match checkout and your shipping policy. Also used by the product timeline and the FAQ.

settings.label: Where it's made
settings.info: e.g. "Made in Yorkshire". Only fill this in if it is literally true for every product. Hidden when blank.

settings.label: Show savings next to compare-at prices
settings.info: Only use compare-at prices that were genuinely charged before.

settings.label: Show the per-night price
settings.info: "About 9p a night over the 5-year guarantee", with the sum one tap away. Needs the guarantee switched on.

settings.label: Mention instalments
settings.info: Only switch on if this is offered at your checkout.

settings.content: Shows a discount you are really running (Shopify admin → Discounts) on product pages, product cards, the basket and the announcement bar. The theme can't read your discount's rules, so make every field below match it exactly. Everything hides itself after the end date, and the basket only ever shows discount lines Shopify has actually applied.

settings.label: Offer name
settings.info: As shoppers should read it, e.g. "Cosy Season Saving". The basket also uses it to recognise your discount once Shopify applies it.

settings.label: Amount off the order (£)
settings.info: A fixed amount off the whole order. Percentage discounts are not supported here.

settings.label: Minimum order (£)
settings.info: The discount's minimum purchase amount. 0 or blank = no minimum.

settings.label: Ends (UK time)
settings.info: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in UK time, exactly as the discount's end date, e.g. 2026-10-31 23:59. Every offer message hides itself from then. Leave blank only if the discount has no end date.

settings.label: Small print
settings.info: One short line under the product-page offer: the discount's significant conditions, e.g. that it can't be combined with other discounts (check Combinations on the discount).
settings.default: No code needed. Can't be combined with other discounts.

settings.label: Count down the last 72 hours
settings.info: Adds "ends in 2 days 4 hrs" to the offer, counted to the end date above, only in its final 72 hours. Only switch on if the discount will really end then, and never extend an offer that has counted down.

settings.content: Product star ratings come from your reviews app (any app that writes Shopify's standard review metafields). Nothing shows until there are real reviews.

settings.label: Store rating
settings.info: e.g. 4.8 — only from a real, verifiable source such as your reviews app. Leave blank to hide every store-rating line.

settings.label: Number of reviews behind it
settings.info: e.g. 3,900 — the real count. Both fields are needed for the line to show.

settings.label: Contact line under Add to basket
settings.info: Real, checkable details, e.g. "Small UK company · Questions? Call or WhatsApp 07598 327268, Mon–Fri 9–5". Links to your contact page. Hidden when blank.

settings.label: How customers can pay
settings.info: Shown near Add to basket and Checkout only while Shopify has no payment icons to show (Settings → Payments), e.g. "Pay by Visa, Mastercard or Maestro". Must match your checkout. Hidden when blank.

settings.label: Show low stock
settings.info: "Only 3 left in Medium" — shown only for sizes Shopify tracks that stop selling at zero. Never invented.

settings.label: Show when stock is at or below
settings.info: Only shows when a variant tracks inventory, can't be oversold, and stock is at or below this. Keep it low so it reflects genuine scarcity. Product cards only flag 2 or fewer.

settings.label: Size hints
settings.info: One size per line: VALUE|Label|Weight|Breeds, plus an optional fifth field: the shortest bed, in cm, for that size. A size option is matched by the breeds it names ("Large: Cocker Spaniel | Staffie" counts as M), else its measurements ("Large · 60 × 45cm" counts as S), else its name (M or Medium; Extra Large, 2XL and XXL count as XL). Used by the size guide, size buttons and the Bed Finder.
settings.default:
XS|Extra small|Up to 5kg|Chihuahua, Yorkie, Pomeranian, Yorkshire Terrier
S|Small|5–10kg|Jack Russell, Dachshund, Pug, Shih Tzu, French Bulldog
M|Medium|10–25kg|Cocker, Springer, Border Collie, Staffie, Cockapoo
L|Large|25–40kg|Labrador, Retriever, Boxer, Pointer
XL|Extra large|40kg+|German Shepherd, Bernese, Great Dane

settings.label: Measuring rule: add (cm)
settings.info: The "measure nose to base of tail, then add 20cm" rule in your size guide. Size buttons whose value gives the bed length ("Large · 71 × 58cm") then say "fits dogs up to ~51cm". Blank or 0 hides that line.

settings.label: Suggested add-on
settings.info: Offered in the basket, never pre-added.

settings.label: Mention discount codes beside Checkout
settings.info: Adds "Discount code? You'll add it at checkout." under the subtotal. Leave off unless you run codes customers already hold (e.g. the email sign-up offer): with no codes it sends people off looking for one.

settings.label: Show "Best for" line
settings.info: From the product's custom.best_for metafield, or a tag like best-for:Stiff mornings.

settings.label: Enable the Bed Finder
settings.info: Four taps to one recommended bed in the right size. Turning it off hides every button that opens it.

settings.content: A full link or just your handle.
